task_goal: Land the spacecraft on the landing pad (0,0) as fast as possible with minimal fuel consumption.
reward_function_interface: def compute_reward(state, m_power, s_power, terminated) -> (float, dict)
state_space: 8-dimensional vector: [x, y, vx, vy, angle, angular_velocity, leg1_contact, leg2_contact]
action_space: Discrete: 0 (do nothing), 1 (fire left orientation engine), 2 (fire main engine), 3 (fire right orientation engine)
termination_modes: terminated flag from game_over (crash) or |state[0]| >= 1.0 (out of viewport) or not lander.awake.
Out of bounds: x coordinate exceeds viewport width.
success_like_ending: Both legs in contact with ground (leg1_contact and leg2_contact == 1).
Lander is on the pad (x near 0, y near helipad).
Low speed at touchdown (vx, vy near 0).
failure_like_endings: terminated flag from game_over (crash) or |state[0]| >= 1.0 (out of viewport) or not lander.awake.
Out of bounds: x coordinate exceeds viewport width.
behavior_trajectory_prior: Phase 1: Stabilize and orient lander upright while descending toward pad.
Phase 2: Controlled descent with main engine throttling to reduce vertical speed near ground.
Phase 3: Final touchdown with both legs contacting ground, minimal lateral velocity, and upright orientation.
reward_design_risks: Hovering indefinitely at high altitude using main engine (avoids crash but never lands).
Landing far from pad but with legs down (gets positive leg contact reward but misses pad).
Using orientation engines excessively causing oscillation or spin.
Firing main engine too late leading to hard landing or crash.
